claims.quote: The underlying cause is mutations in SCN1A, encoding the sodium channel subunit NaV1.1, in >90% of patients.
SCN1A, encoding the sodium channel subunit NaV1.1,

Increasing functional NaV1.1 via antisense oligonucleotides or virus-borne vectors is the most promising avenue for meaningful improvement in Dravet syndrome treatment, with the potential to not only reduce seizures but also address the multiple co-morbidities associated with this disease.
